spanish: No ahora sea como el muerto, que en su salir desde vientre de su madre, y es comido mitad de su carne.

findings.issue: «ahora» adds a temporal adverb; the token is an entreaty particle, not a time word.
Sequential imperfect niphal is smoothed to present «es»; passive 3ms is kept.

notes: The jussive, comparison, relative, infinitive, womb, mother, half, and flesh follow the tokens.
